_comment: Security headers for the MKA rebuild.
This file must sit at the DEPLOYMENT ROOT, not inside the site folder —
Vercel reads it before the build runs. build.mjs deletes the copy that
lands in dist/ so it is never served as a static file. The copy kept here
in the repo is the versioned source of truth.
The CSP is strict — no 'unsafe-inline' anywhere — which the site can
afford because it has no inline styles, no inline scripts and no external
requests. Adding an analytics tag or an embedded map later means widening
this policy deliberately rather than discovering it is already wide open.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
